question:
**Select the option which means the same as the group of words given.**

The sovereign head of a state
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monarch**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Let's understand the meaning of the given options:__ 

 
• **Monochrome**: Having or appearing to have only one color.
 
• **Monarch**: A nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right.
 
• **Monolith**: A single great stone (often in the form of a column or obelisk)
 
• **Monotone**: Sounded or spoken in a tone unvarying in pitch

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
